name: @sprigr/apps-faceted-search
description: Reusable, parameterized faceted-catalog search UI for Sprigr marketplace app dashboards and agent-built static websites. Dark facet rail with live counts, chips, sub-search, range filters, pagination, skeletons. Three data sources (gateway tool, search key, custom). Ships raw TS source for the sprigrVendor pattern, plus a standalone IIFE embed build with a global mount()/unmount() API.

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts embed/mount.ts --format esm --dts --out-dir dist --clean --tsconfig tsconfig.build.json
